hook_text: 3,45 plus 2,8 is not 3,73. One tiny habit fixes it.
clip_script: Drakensberg camp! We hike 3,45 km to the waterfall and 2,8 km to the cave. How far? Do not line up the last digits. Line up the commas! 2,8 becomes 2,80. 5 plus 0 is 5. 4 plus 8 is 12, carry 1. 3 plus 2 plus 1 is 6. That is 6,25 km. Now the trail is 10 km. Write 10,00, borrow, and 3,75 km is left. Check it: 3,75 plus 6,25 is 10. Commas in a line, every time!
visual_style: Mountain trail with distance signs, then numbers sliding into columns with the commas snapping into a glowing straight line.
mood: Outdoorsy and upbeat, like a camp leader on a hike.
pacing: Quick trail shots, slow column working, then a fast check at the end.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out the change from R100 for the camp shopping.
